narr_welcome.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_welcome.text: Welcome to the Big Meadow Race! Zippy and Tomo are waiting at the Big Oak.

narr_tap_olly.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_tap_olly.text: Tap Judge Olly to start the race!

narr_hold.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_hold.text: Now it's your turn to help Tomo. Press and hold your finger on the screen to make him walk.

narr_hold_hint.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_hold_hint.text: Press and hold, and Tomo will walk!

narr_stream.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_stream.text: Splish, splash! Here is Giggle Stream.

narr_shh.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_shh.text: Shhh! Zippy is having a nap. Let's tiptoe past, very quietly.

narr_ten.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_ten.text: Ten strawberries! What a super picnic!

narr_none.speaker: NARRATOR
narr_none.text: Next time, let's find some strawberries!

tomo_share.speaker: TOMO
tomo_share.text: Strawberries for everyone! Thank you for helping me.
